subject.title: feat: add readiness conditions and providers

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `gateway.readiness` and `registerReadinessCriterion` as supported long-term public contracts, including the deliberate fail-closed behavior for operator-selected criteria?
rationale: The patch is not only a local readiness refactor: it creates new configuration, Gateway RPC, CLI, status, and Plugin SDK contracts whose permanent scope and upgrade expectations need maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor the readiness contract
options.body: Approve the opt-in contract after a clean rebase and exact-head proof for both legacy and selected-criterion upgrade paths.

options.title: Narrow the initial scope
options.body: Accept only a smaller core readiness projection and defer plugin registration, subject identity, or additional public surfaces to separate approved proposals.

options.title: Decline the new public surface
options.body: Keep the existing fixed Gateway readiness behavior and close the feature direction without merging the broader contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the readiness contract
recommendation.body: Approve the opt-in contract after a clean rebase and exact-head proof for both legacy and selected-criterion upgrade paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposal author can clarify the intended compatibility boundary and split the stack if maintainers choose a narrower product direction.
